theorem.input: Horn or dual-Horn CNF H and affine GF(2) system A
theorem.capability_rule: for one fixed exponent q, close only when 2^d <= L^q

constructive_advance: Replaces raw shared-boundary size by affine continuation dimension and composes dense large-interface instances when their affine projection is low-dimensional.
proof_operations: particular solution and nullspace basis construction
complete enumeration of projected affine states
Horn least-model witness or conflict trace
forbidden_promotions: treating q as an unbounded instance input
claiming polynomiality when 2^d exceeds the committed budget
using finite audit counts as the theorem
promoting OPEN to UNSAT or intrinsic hardness
promoting one restricted obstruction to P!=NP
claim_boundary: Exact only for Horn/dual-Horn plus affine under a fixed polynomial state capability; unrestricted Horn-affine mixtures, arbitrary CNF and P versus NP remain open.
